notes.title: THE SUPPER: NEW BLOOD DEMO REMASTERED!
notes.content:
[p]Greetings, everyone!
[/p][p]We’re delighted to announce that we've uploaded a [i]remastered[/i] version of [i]The Supper: New Blood Demo[/i]![/p][p]The previous one was a bit outdated in terms of GUI and quality of life stuff, so we've made many changes to make it more similar to the final game.
[/p][p]We hope you enjoy it, and if you do, give the full game a try!
[/p][p]Thanks for your support,[/p][p]Octavi & Susanna[/p][p]White Blanket Games[/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: Hotfix 1.02
notes.content: [p]Hotfix 1.02:[/p][list][*][p]Fixed a bug where the register book remained on screen after choosing a guest to interrogate.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where the location markers in maps got stuck when quitting to the menu.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where players could skip cutscenes, resulting in essential items not being added to the inventory.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a couple of misaligned menus.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]This little patch will fix three of the more annoying bugs currently in the game.[/p][p]In the coming days, we'll keep releasing patches fixing and improving many things.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you all for your support! <3<3[/p][p][/p][p]Octavi & Susanna[/p]

notes.title: The Supper: New Blood, available now!
notes.content:
[p]Greetings everyone!
[/p][p]After a crazy year of development (and some bumps in the road), we’re really excited to announce the release of [i]The Supper: New Blood[/i]! 
[/p][p]We wanted to thank you all for supporting us all this time.
[/p][p]We put our heart into this hilarious and bizarre game, so we really hope you enjoy it. We think we've cooked up something special!
[/p][p]If you find any bugs (we hope not), please let us know in the forums/comments so we can fix them asap.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you <3!
[/p][p]Octavi & Susanna
[/p][p]P.d: You can get it 10% off for the first two weeks, so… what are you waiting for? ;)[/p][p]
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45067580/5002b947542f06a15b1ec44fc22c2b1029c848d5.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: The Supper: New Blood Release Date!!
notes.content:
[p]Hi everyone![/p][p]We have very exciting news to share with you! We have a release date for [i]The Supper: New Blood[/i]!! Yay![/p][p]Our craziest Point and Click Adventure game will see the light on [b]August 26th.[/b][/p][p]Save the date!
[/p][p]Get ready for the Plat du jour!
[/p][p]Octavi & Susanna[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45067580/3876335db84711369f435e950c2d0852b59a5160.png"][/img][/p]

Don’t miss the chance to meet Stewie and taste his… *cough*… delicious cuisine.
